risk_summary: The excerpt is highly quantified and provides detailed reconciliations, but emphasizes adjusted non-GAAP results that exclude a substantial TCJA charge. Reported earnings declined materially in the fourth quarter and full year, while asbestos-related liabilities, debt extinguishment costs, acquisition costs, currency effects, and strategic investments represent notable risk factors. Overall tone is operationally confident but moderated by significant one-time charges and liability exposure.
